events.verdict: Bender (PHX) sets the pick in Wiggins's (MIN) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Crawford (PHX) splits his feet at the start of the drive.
Bender (PHX) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Towns (MIN) makes contact to the arm of Crawford (PHX) during his shooting motion on his jump shot attempt.
Towns (MIN) establishes himself in a picking position in Warren's (PHX) path and some contact occurs to his arms, but the contact is marginal.
Bender (PHX) makes marginal contact to Rose's (MIN) body during his shooting motion on his driving shot attempt.
Warren (PHX) makes contact to the body of Wiggins (MIN) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt. The body contact occurs prior to Warren dislodging the ball.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) and Gibson (MIN) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
Bender (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position on Okogie (MIN) at the end of the drive.
Bender (PHX) makes marginal contact to the body of Gibson (MIN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.
Crawford (PHX) commits a take foul on Rose (MIN).
Acy (PHX) initiates contact with Gibson (MIN) during the free throw attempt, but the contact is marginal.
Gibson (MIN) makes incidental contact with Booker's (PHX) hand on the ball as he dislodges the ball.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) and Gibson (MIN) make incidental contact during the loose ball situation.
Rose (MIN) briefly dribbles the ball off of his leg but does not discontinue his dribble.
Wiggins (MIN) briefly grasps Booker (PHX) during the inbound but does not affect his SQBR.
Acy (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Gibson (MIN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
